title: Automorphism pullback commutes with completion with a unique unit normalization
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring and $d$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum with finitely generated ideal $I\subseteq A$, additive-torsion $A/I$, and finite perfect quotients $A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Work on the chosen small pro-etale site, with $A_X=\varprojlim_n(A/I^n)_X$, coefficient universe one above the scheme universe, and $\mathcal D=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$. Fix any finite tuple $a$ generating $I$. Let $L:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be the Koszul completion reflector of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector], with the explicit intrinsic unit $\eta_M:M\to LM$ of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] on specified cochain representatives; $\mathcal C$ is the full subcategory where this unit is invertible.

Let $e:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ be a scheme automorphism. Give ordinary module pullback the coefficient isomorphism $c_e:e^{-1}A_X\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X$ induced by the constant quotient comparisons and the inverse-image limit comparison [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let $H=Le^*$ be the resulting ordinary derived pullback and $G=Re_*$ its module right adjoint, using the adjunction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. Both $H$ and $G$ preserve $\mathcal C$, and their adjoint equivalence restricts to $\mathcal C$. For every $M\in\mathcal D$ there is a unique isomorphism
$$c_M:H(LM)\xrightarrow{\sim}L(HM),\qquad H(\eta_M);c_M=\eta_{HM}.$$
These claims hold for the actual completed coefficient sheaf and the specified intrinsic units, for every finite generating tuple and every representative, without a constructibility or boundedness hypothesis.

proof.text: Identify WfIsComplete for the fixed tuple with PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete. For the forward implication take the canonical actual representative C, transport it by the coefficient restriction to the published presentation, and use the inverse restriction equivalence B. The actual chain unit is the round-trip isomorphism followed by B applied to the published unit. The exact-derived factorization and reflection of isomorphisms show that the published unit is invertible. The scalar adjunction identifies this transported representative with derived extension along the inverse coefficient comparison, providing the required existential witness. The converse is sfConstructibleCanonicalReflectorComplete, the canonical-representative specialization of canonical completeness. Isomorphism invariance of PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete follows by composing its witnessing realization with derived extension of the given isomorphism.

proof.text: Membership in PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete is equivalent to invertibility of the actual reflection unit: its full inclusion is a right adjoint, and the unit is invertible exactly on its essential image. The actual direct-image/completion comparison c satisfies eta_(GM);c_M = G(eta_M). Both c_M and G are equivalences, hence this equation shows that GM is complete if and only if M is complete. The actual adjunction unit identifies M with GHM, so completeness of M implies completeness of HM. Convert both preservation assertions to WfIsComplete using Step 2. Restrict the actual adjunction along the fully faithful inclusions with the definitionally commuting lift squares. The restricted Hom transpose is the ambient transpose by restrictFullyFaithful_homEquiv_apply. Both restricted functors are fully faithful, so their adjunction unit and counit are invertible.

proof.text: For an arbitrary representative C of M, completedKoszulQuotientComparison gives c from its specified completion to the actual strict quotient limit of M, with eta_C;c equal to the quotient unit. Apply the same theorem to the canonical representative to get c0 with eta_canonical;c0 equal to exactly the same quotient unit. Thus k=c;c0 inverse identifies the arbitrary output with wfCompletionObj M and eta_C;k=wfCompletionUnit M. The reflector theorem makes the latter output complete. Isomorphism invariance gives completeness of the arbitrary output. Conjugating maps by k and using its unit equation transports the canonical Hom bijection to the arbitrary eta_C.

proof.text: For a complete N, GN is complete by Step 3. The Hom bijection of the adjunction takes precomposition by H(eta_C) to precomposition by eta_C. Step 4 therefore proves that H(eta_C) has the reflection mapping property into all complete targets. Its output H(LC) is complete by Step 3, and the completion on the specified target representative D is complete by Step 4. The two Hom bijections give maps f and g between these outputs satisfying H(eta_C);f=eta_D and eta_D;g=H(eta_C). Injectivity of the two Hom bijections gives f;g=1 and g;f=1. Thus f defines an isomorphism, and the same injectivity proves uniqueness among all isomorphisms with the required unit equation. There are no nonempty-tuple, boundedness, constructibility or nonempty-scheme assumptions.
